anti_duplication_rules: Keep RM-001 and RM-002 as reconciliation/proof tickets unless the proof commands expose a real implementation gap; do not reopen completed WAVE-015 through WAVE-108 behavior under this tranche.

Route all reindex repair proof through packages/svs_common/svs_common/maintenance.py:reindex_chunks and the existing worker/API maintenance path; do not create a second indexing repair worker or ad hoc dense/sparse replay path.

Keep OpenAPI contract behavior in packages/svs_common/svs_common/schemas.py plus apps/api/svs_api/main.py:custom_openapi and tests/test_openapi_contract.py; do not add route-local schema hacks that bypass named components.

Make Alembic the only migration authority after RM-003; do not add new raw SQL migration loops, and do not parallelize migration/RLS work that touches scripts/migrate.sh, db/migrations/*, migrations/*, .github/workflows/*, or tests/integration/test_postgres_rls_and_worker.py.

Keep release image enumeration in scripts/release/release_common.py and digest/provenance handling in scripts/release/provenance_common.py; do not duplicate APP_IMAGES or image tag construction in build, publish, launch, or proof scripts.

Serialize deployment work that touches release_common.py, build-images.py, publish-images.py, compose.cell.yml, prod-env-preflight.py, or .env.production.example; image provenance, encrypted secrets, customer launch, and DNS/TLS proof must land in an explicit order.

Validate production secrets through scripts/release/prod-env-preflight.py and packages/svs_common/svs_common/secrets.py; do not print secret values, write plaintext production secrets, or invent per-script secret parsing.

Serialize API-key, admin auth, and tenant-isolation changes that touch apps/api/svs_api/main.py, packages/svs_common/svs_common/auth.py, apps/admin_ui/src/main.tsx, or apps/admin_ui/src/auth.ts; the backend principal remains the security authority.

Serialize provider-routing changes across configs/model-registry.yaml, packages/svs_common/svs_common/providers.py, packages/svs_common/svs_common/provider_probe.py, apps/model_gateway/svs_model_gateway/main.py, and apps/api/svs_api/main.py; bakeoff, private endpoints, and live provider proof must share one probe/result contract.

Route backup and restore artifact metadata through scripts/release/backup_common.py; do not add unmanifested bundles, unchecked object copies, or restore scripts that skip checksum/preflight validation.

Route observability evidence through infra/docker/compose.observability.yml, charts/exais-observability/*, and scripts/release/observability-smoke.py; do not create one-off metric names that dashboards and alerts cannot scrape.

Treat RM-012 through RM-017 as proof/runbook gates; do not mark those tickets implemented without operator-supplied registry credentials, target host, live provider credentials, external backup target, production-scale corpus, DNS control, TLS path, and secret-manager wiring as applicable.

tickets.expected_output: Reindex repair status is reconciled by running the existing API/worker maintenance proof against non-indexed dense and sparse chunks, updating docs only when the proof passes, and filing a concrete implementation gap only if the proof fails.
Generated OpenAPI contract proof and tests establish the current native/OpenAI route coverage; README, ticket trail, and completion matrix agree without reopening the completed OpenAI parity train.
Alembic owns schema migration, production-like upgrade/RLS checks run in CI, rollback or forward-fix discipline is documented, and raw-loop migration bypasses fail a repeatable drift check.
CI can build the full versioned app image set, emit digest/provenance manifests, and validate pinned image metadata for local micro-production cells without claiming external registry proof.
Production cell configuration accepts encrypted secret references, rejects plaintext placeholders, validates references without value disclosure, and documents rotation and rollback handling.

Backup commands produce verifiable manifests for metadata, vectors, sparse indexes, object/config/audit artifacts, and restore preflight can enumerate and validate those artifacts without destructive restore.
A local cell observability stack scrapes API, worker, index, storage, security, cost, and backup metrics; dashboards, alerts, and a smoke command prove key metrics are visible.

Admin UI production requests use session/OIDC/API-key principal context resolved by the API, dev headers fail closed outside dev mode, and UI/API tests cover unauthorized, expired, and scoped requests.
Authorized admins can switch instance/business context, view running component versions and image digests, inspect deployment records, and identify stale or unverifiable cells without shell access.

Bakeoff runs fan out a golden query set across retrieval/model candidates, persist comparable quality/latency/cost metrics, apply selection/rejection policy, and expose deterministic plus live-provider commands.

Private RunPod, TEI, Infinity, and compatible endpoint adapters normalize embedding/rerank calls through the gateway and expose health, latency, security level, region, revision, and auth-reference status.

Operator proof gate records external registry credentials, versioned image push, immutable digests, clean pull-by-digest evidence, and an explicit statement that VPS/customer readiness is not claimed by this proof alone.

Operator proof gate records a chosen VPS/customer host pulling pinned external images, passing production preflight, booting the cell, proving API/admin/worker/model-gateway readiness, and running retrieval smoke.

Operator proof gate records live OpenAI, RunPod, TEI, Infinity, and approved provider checks through the gateway, including routing policy, latency/error/cost metadata, and explicit unavailable/unapproved providers.

Operator proof gate records an external cell or staging clone restore from a real backup target, including metadata, object artifacts, one Qdrant collection, one OpenSearch index, config/secrets references, and retrieval/eval smoke.

Operator proof gate records target corpus or documented surrogate load-test results for ingestion throughput, p95 search/context latency, freshness, index growth, provider latency, and failure modes against SLOs.

Operator proof gate records DNS resolution, HTTPS/TLS health without dev wildcards, external secret-manager reference validation without disclosure, and rollback/rotation steps for the chosen production domain/cell.
